name: Cloud Sweet Cupid Dream
image_purpose: fantasy fashion campaign and conceptual lookbook

prompt.project_info: Create a bright high-key fantasy fashion portrait in a cloud landscape with playful cupid-inspired props and fully covered styling.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman with messy blonde updo, soft face-framing curls, dewy makeup and wispy lashes, wearing a glossy red fully covered short dress with opaque matching tights, pale pink feathered wings, textured gold bow, and a red heart-tipped arrow held as a prop; dynamic crouched three-quarter pose with secure clothing.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body centered vertical portrait, head tilted, white clouds surrounding the subject, clean white and petal-pink palette with gold and soft-red accents, clear silhouette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Large diffused softbox, high-key even light, extremely soft shadows, glowy controlled highlights, romantic whimsical dream mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Sharp facial focus with gentle highlight bloom, realistic latex-like glossy fabric without transparency, detailed feather texture, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-key full-body fantasy fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman in a fully covered glossy red short dress with opaque red tights, pale pink feathered wings, textured gold bow, and red heart-tipped arrow prop, messy blonde updo, soft curls, dewy makeup, centered three-quarter crouched pose with secure clothing, surrounded by large white clouds, pastel pink and clean white palette, diffused softbox lighting, realistic feathers and fabric, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, open hips, lingerie, sheer fabric, fetish styling, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, watermark, logo, text

assets.name: cloud cupid fashion reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the cloud environment, pastel palette, wings, gold bow, heart prop, hairstyle, and centered fantasy composition; replace lingerie-like styling with full coverage and keep identity replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the romantic cloud-cupid concept and physical prop details, while using clearly adult presentation, opaque full coverage, and a nonsexual balanced pose. Identity and costume details remain replaceable.

policy_review.changes: Replaced open-hip lingerie styling with a fully covered dress and opaque tights; clarified the subject as a clearly adult fictional person.
policy_review.notes: Fantasy styling and prop interaction are non-graphic.
